issue_request: FHIR-17930 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ClaimResponse and requested renaming ClaimResponse .reserve/.reserved to fundsReserve to match Claim, with the element relocated to follow the payee information.
initial_application: The 2018-11-05 FM batch commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly listed 17930 and renamed the spreadsheet row from ClaimResponse.reserved to ClaimResponse.fundsReserve. The R3/R4 rename map also records ClaimResponse.reserved=ClaimResponse.fundsReserve. That initial application did not complete the placement portion: the spreadsheet, 2021 StructureDefinition source conversion, R5 tag, and current source all kept fundsReserve after ClaimResponse.payment.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml the authoritative current-build source for the resource. The current ClaimResponse root uses payeeType rather than a payee backbone, so payeeType is the current placement target corresponding to the issue's payee wording. Searches found no later Jira, Zulip, or Confluence decision superseding the requested placement. FHIR-53057 later changed FM resource binding context, so the current preferred binding was preserved unchanged.
reconciliation: Moved ClaimResponse.fundsReserve from after ClaimResponse.payment.identifier to immediately after ClaimResponse.payeeType. The edit preserved the element's definition, type, cardinality, binding, and comments; only source element order changed.
